python_requests_example.code:
import requests

url = "http://localhost:8002/api/chat/vector_inference"

payload = {
    "input": {
        "workflow_id": "inference_001",
        "client_id": "dpac",
        "project_id": "dpac_portal",
        "session_id": "session_123",
        "user_id": "user_456",
        "input_text": "What is the D.PaC?",
        "language": "en",
        "top_k": 5,
        "limit": 10
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, json=payload)
print(response.json())
